name: normed QKV face-off
command: cat /tmp/dump_stage_rms.cpp | ssh -o BatchMode=yes luigi@spark 'cat > ~/bonsai2/asm/dump_stage_rms.cpp' 2>&1; cat /tmp/fwd8.c | ssh -o BatchMode=yes luigi@spark 'cat > ~/bonsai2/asm/fwd8.c && cd ~/bonsai2/asm && F=~/bonsai2/llama.cpp B=~/bonsai2/llama.cpp/build && g++ -O2 -o dump_stage_rms dump_stage_rms.cpp -I$F/include -I$F/ggml/include -L$B/bin -lllama -lggml -lggml-base -Wl,-rpath,$B/bin -lm 2>&1 | grep -i error | head -3; gcc -O2 -march=armv8.2-a+dotprod -c fwd8.c -o fwd8.o 2>&1 | grep -i " error" | head -3; LB=$B/bin && gcc -O2 -o fwd8 fwd8.o fwd8_pq2.o -L$LB -lggml-base -lggml-cpu -Wl,-rpath,$LB -lm 2>&1 | head -3 && echo BUILD_OK && taskset -c 3 ./dump_stage_rms ../models/bonsai8b-PQ2_0.gguf 872 2>/dev/null | grep -A2 "Qcur_normed-0\|Kcur_normed-0\|Vcur-0 \|embd " | head -16' 2>&1 | head -20
